title: Strict-prior delayed recurrence of leading pair-residual spectral subspaces

target_design.cutoff_rule: For target index i, compute current leading k=2 pair-residual subspace from draws[:i] only. Compare it with the subspace computed from draws[:i-lag], for fixed lag in {2,3,5}. No target quintet or future draw values enter either subspace.

hypothesis: At least one preregistered lag in {2,3,5} has label-aligned leading k=2 subspace overlap greater than a constrained node-label permutation null in both Validation and historical Blind OOS.

subspace.construction: For each prefix i, calculate pair_residual_graph(draws[:i]); difference against the immediately preceding prefix graph; apply Q90 additive-main-effect decomposition; take the leading Q93 k=2 eigen-subspace with Q93 tie-expansion rule.
subspace.overlap: sum((V_current.T @ V_lagged)^2) / min(effective_current_modes, effective_lagged_modes); zero when either basis is empty.

permutation_null.transformation: Apply one fixed row permutation p to the lagged basis V_lagged[p,:] while leaving current basis unchanged. This preserves orthonormality and the all-ones-orthogonal subspace while disrupting node-label correspondence.
permutation_null.classification: Constrained node-label permutation null; not a Haar-random subspace null or universal graph null.

statistics.test_statistic: Within each lag and chronological split, compare mean observed overlap with the 999 fixed-permutation mean-over-target statistics using plus-one one-sided p-value.
statistics.uncertainty: Circular moving-block bootstrap of per-target observed-minus-per-target-permutation-mean overlap; block length 20; 2000 replicates; 95% percentile interval.
statistics.multiple_testing: One global Holm family of nine tests: three fixed lags multiplied by three chronological splits.
statistics.primary_gate: At least one fixed lag must have positive excess overlap, strictly positive bootstrap 95% lower bound and global Holm p<0.05 in both Validation and historical Blind OOS. Otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED.

safeguards: Verify Q95 acceptance manifest, validation and every manifested artifact hash before using its source state.
Recompute every spectral basis from strict archive prefixes only.
Lagged prefix index must be strictly earlier than the current prefix and both must precede the target.
Permutation transformations are inferential controls only and never forecast inputs.
No target outcomes are needed or read by this diagnostic.
All nine lag-by-split tests are corrected in one global Holm family.
Historical Blind OOS is exploratory, not virgin prospective confirmation.
No immutable freeze modification, prospective shadow insertion, model promotion or automatic merge.
known_limitations: The constrained node-label permutation null is not a Haar null or a universal graph null.
Subspace overlap is geometric and does not imply causality or predictive value.
Lagged recurrence may be affected by overlapping rolling prefixes; the block bootstrap addresses local dependence only approximately.
Failure to reject does not prove absence of every possible temporal structure.
Q60 prospective promotion remains blocked until at least 200 complete paired prospective targets are available.
next_action: Run Q96 strict-prior walk-forward and independent exact replay. If no lag passes both Validation and historical Blind OOS after the global Holm correction, close this spectral-recurrence line and concentrate on Q92 acceptance and Q60 append-only prospective collection.
